_README: Labeled queries for EVAL.md. 50 cases across 12 question shapes.
Every label was written by opening the clause in the corpus and phrasing
the question the way a person would ask it, deliberately avoiding the
clause's distinctive wording so nothing leaks into a contextual-header
experiment. `source` names what was read.
! STILL NEEDS DOMAIN REVIEW. Whether a clause genuinely ANSWERS a question
is a lawyer's judgement, not a retrieval engineer's. A wrong label is worse
than no label: it silently moves every dial EVAL.md gates. Run
`python eval/audit.py` to see where each labelled target actually ranks --
a target that no arm ever surfaces is the first place to look for a bad
label rather than a bad engine.
TYPES
conceptual     natural question, no reference given
authority      'who has the power to ...' -- the commonest real question
numeric        a deadline, percentage, or amount; one right number
sanction       what penalty attaches to a breach
exception      the carve-out, not the rule · retrieval must not return
the general obligation and call it an answer
obligation     'is X required to ...'
procedural     how something is done, or what happens if it is not
exact_ref      user names the regulation; exercises the routing bypass.
Scored against `answer_regulation`, so the label is
mechanical -- any chunk of the named regulation counts.
multi_tier     answered by BOTH a parent law and its implementing rule.
Indonesian regulation is layered; a label naming only one
scores a correct retrieval as a miss.
underspecified the question as asked has several equally correct answers.
Kept deliberately: users ask these, and an engine that
surfaces any one of them has not failed.
hard_negative  a near-identical clause about a DIFFERENT subject must not
outrank the right one. `must_not_rank_first` lists them.
out_of_domain  the corpus cannot answer this. Correct behaviour is EMPTY
(CLAUDE.md invariant 13). Note the Indonesian-language
cases: they separate 'detects the domain' from 'detects
the language', which a language check would conflate.
corpus: spike-01 (181,807 chunks, 10,881 regulations, 1945-2018)

queries.query: Apakah pengelola energi diwajibkan memakai teknologi yang tidak merusak lingkungan?
Apakah penghasilan anggota Komisi Yudisial disamakan dengan hakim Mahkamah Agung?
Siapa yang berwenang menetapkan kelas jalan provinsi?
queries.note: Both read and both answer: PP 79/2013 says the class is set by keputusan gubernur after the road ministry's advice; UU 22/2009 says 'pemerintah provinsi, untuk jalan provinsi'. The original label named only the implementing rule, so retrieval putting the parent law first scored as a miss. That was the label failing, not the engine.

queries.query: Denda apa yang dikenakan kalau melanggar aturan cukai untuk pertama kalinya?
queries.note: ! The question has NINE correct answers. PP 26/2009 sets a different first-offence fine for each kind of breach — Rp1jt, Rp2,5jt, Rp5jt, Rp10jt, Rp20jt, Rp25jt, and two expressed as multiples of the excise value. Any one of them is a correct retrieval. Kept as-is because users really do ask questions this shape; scoring it against a single chunk would have been a fabricated failure.

queries.query: PP 26 tahun 2009
queries.note: Bare identifier, almost no semantic content — it scores 0.5355 against the nearest cluster centroid, the lowest of any in-domain query. Exactly why invariant 4 forbids gating the identifier path on routing.

queries.query: Undang-Undang Nomor 4 Tahun 2009 tentang pertambangan
queries.note: reference plus topic; both paths should agree

queries.query: Untuk unit transfusi darah tingkat provinsi, siapa yang mengeluarkan izinnya?
queries.note: three tiers in one clause (Menteri / provinsi / kabupaten-kota); a hit must be the clause, not merely the topic

queries.note: local tier · national-tier regulations dominate the corpus, so this checks routing does not simply prefer UU and PP

Apakah makanan olahan buatan industri rumah tangga tetap wajib punya izin edar?
queries.note: the answer is the carve-out in ayat (2); returning only the general obligation would be wrong

queries.query: Apakah semua penyembelihan hewan harus dilakukan di rumah potong hewan?
queries.source: UNDANG-UNDANG 18/2009 Pasal 61 — PETERNAKAN DAN KESEHATAN HEWAN
queries.note: answer is 'no' — religious-holiday slaughter is excepted; a yes-shaped retrieval is a real failure

queries.query: Apa kewajiban pengelola tempat kerja terhadap kesehatan pekerjanya?
Apakah pelabuhan wajib menyediakan peralatan penanggulangan pencemaran?

queries.source: PERATURAN DAERAH KOTA 17/2011 Pasal 18 — RETRIBUSI PELAYANAN PASAR
queries.note: local tier · many regencies have near-identical retribution rules, so precision here is genuinely hard

queries.query: Berapa lama wawancara seleksi berlangsung dan kapan hasilnya diumumkan panitia?
queries.source: PERATURAN PRESIDEN 76/2016 Pasal 26 — PEMILIHAN ANGGOTA BADAN PELAKSANA
queries.note: the source text has OCR damage ('(l)', '(21') — a real-corpus condition, not a reason to exclude it

queries.query: Apa batas wilayah sebelah utara Kabupaten Pidie Jaya?
queries.source: UNDANG-UNDANG 7/2007 Pasal 5 — PEMBENTUKAN KABUPATEN PIDIE JAYA
queries.note: ! The strongest discrimination test in the set. Dozens of 'pembentukan kabupaten' laws carry a near-identical Pasal 5 differing only in place names, so lexical overlap is nearly total and only the specific regency separates right from wrong.

queries.query: Provinsi Banten berbatasan dengan apa di sebelah timur?
queries.note: same family as q039, province tier, and spelled 'Propinsi' in the source against 'Provinsi' in the question

queries.query: Kelas jalan kabupaten ditetapkan dengan keputusan siapa?
queries.note: same clause pair as q003 but asking about a different tier of road · both clauses enumerate all four tiers

queries.query: Peraturan Presiden Nomor 76 Tahun 2016
UU No. 17 Tahun 2013 tentang organisasi kemasyarakatan
queries.note: ! There is also UU 17/2008 (Pelayaran) and PP 17/2013. The year and type both have to be honoured, not just the number.

queries.query: PP 60/2014 dana desa
queries.note: slash-form identifier plus a topic word

queries.query: chocolate chip cookie recipe
how do I rotate a matrix in numpy
resep rendang daging sapi yang empuk dan bumbunya meresap
queries.note: ! Indonesian, but not legal. Separates domain detection from language detection — a check that merely asks 'is this Indonesian?' passes this and should not.

queries.query: cara memperbaiki keran air yang bocor di dapur
queries.note: Indonesian, everyday register, and 'air' is a heavily-used corpus term (hak guna air, sumber daya air) — lexical overlap without topical relevance

queries.query: siapa pemenang piala dunia 2018
queries.note: Indonesian, and shaped exactly like an in-domain authority question ('siapa ... 2018') — the shape must not be what triggers a match

queries.query: what is the capital of France
